components.text: The same purification, worked with holy water instead of glowstone dust: holy damage (8 by default, 4 hearts) to every undead creature within 8 blocks of the centre, Tensura undead and vanilla undead.

Anyone can perform it. Tensura and Vampirism must be installed: the holy water is Vampirism's.

It does not tell friend from foe: undead allies within 8 blocks are hit too, and the reach is wider than the circle.
